name: smoke
description: Two small tasks that show the suite format: a bug fix judged by tests, and a question judged by the answer.

cases.name: fix-sum
cases.prompt: The tests in test_sum.py fail. Fix the bug in sum.py so that `python3 -m unittest` passes. Do not change the tests.

cases.name: count-files
cases.prompt: How many .py files are in the working directory? Answer with the number only.
